notes.title: Important Bug Fix for Johanna, Hitomi and Angelica
notes.notes:
Version 0.6.9 brought a bug which stops you from starting the Quests for Johanna, Hitomi and Angelica.
This has been fixed now and we're truly sorry for the inconvenience, we promise better testing in future versions.

- Fix: onVisit Event for Johanna at the Gym
- Fix: onVisit Event for Hitomi at the Bakery
- Fix: Playing Memories while in the City Overview
- Fix: Questmarker for Hitomi Act3
- Fix: Hints for all Character
- Fix: Missing memory from Hitomi's Story, all memories are now unlockable.

Please make sure you're on version 0.6.94, which contains the fix.

notes.title: Jugs Bay v0.4 Development Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Jugs Bay Update Coming This September[/h1]

Thank you for the positive feedback on our early access release. Your support has been genuinely moving. We're now gearing up for our next major update this September.

This post focuses on technical improvements, and a story & content update post will soon follow.

[h2]Development Progress[/h2]

[h3]New Feature: Placeable Items[/h3]
A new system allows you to place specific items on designated Placement Maps in various locations.

[b]Key Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Grid Placement[/b]: Place, move, and remove items on a grid.
[*] [b]Diverse Item Types[/b]: Purchase a variety of items from different stores, each offering unique benefits:
[*] [b]Profit[/b]: Additional ways to earn income.
[*] [b]Plants[/b]: Grow over time and harvest.
[*] Possibility for [b]Machines [/b]in future updates: Craft advanced products for selling.
[/list]

[h3][b]Locations with Placeable Items[/b][/h3]
[h3]Home Terrace: Balcony Garden[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993247/ae21b392b99ce18cc8414b143e89d3b46d3e8c33.gif[/img]

Transform your terrace into a thriving garden by purchasing and planting various flowers and plants, watching them grow over a specific number of days, harvesting crops for crafting and gifting, and increasing your yield by expanding your garden.


[h3]Home Rooftop: Solar Panel Installation[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993247/02f768eb0150a9a3021fcae433a01abf162e0863.gif[/img]

Purchase and install solar panels on your roof to generate energy that is sold automatically at the end of each day, earning passive income with a lower entry barrier than bank deposits, with future updates potentially allowing installation on lovers homes.



[h3]Memory Gallery Overhaul[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993247/2cca1fd093f0d2f9ea009bf5849bff5cad8da14b.gif[/img]

The improved interface for easier navigation of unlocked scenes now features a updated phone UI with a larger screen, displays the total number of unlocked and unlockable memories, and includes new filters for sorting memories by categories and characters



[h3]Trading / Shop Window Overhaul (In Progress)[/h3]

This feature is still in development. For the latest updates, join our Discord or follow us on Patreon. The overhaul aims to:

[list]
[*] Provide more space for sorting items by usability.
[*] Improve the buying and selling experience.
[*] Improve design for displaying the items and their price.
[/list]


[h3]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/h3]
We've addressed the reported bugs, thanks to everyone who helped identify them.


[b]Hotfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed: Stuck at Susan Lewd Scene Motorboat and can’t progress.
[*] Fixed: Meet Hitomi Achievement can now also be unlocked when approaching her in the Bakery.
[*] Fixed: Memory Video Preview.
[*] Fixed: Wrong Quest Log updates on playing memories.
[*] Fixed: Crafting will reduce energy by 10 from 11.
[*] Fixed: Random Sauna scene with Kaya which could not be triggered.
[*] Fixed: Various memories not shown properly in the memory gallery.
[/list]


We greatly appreciate everyone who has reported bugs and crashes. Please continue to report any issues via Steam forums or our Discord server.


Thank you and see you next time.
